## 80bd3177b03c

**Reproduced distribution shortcut — the sampler covers only clear horizontal pairs while the authority is broader.** Generator SHA-256 `5993570c739ac419ff3236ba4082dce99645752d74695fc930d8d4023e25ca67` states that same-row **or same-column** pairs are connected when the path is clear. Across 600 generated inputs, the probe counted 1,928 clear horizontal pairs and exactly zero vertical pairs, blocked pairs, singleton colors, colors occurring more than twice, or unaligned two-cell colors. All 600 generated inputs passed the generator's current `self_check`.

The five canonical inputs exercise materially broader branches: 5 clear vertical pairs, 1 blocked vertical pair, 1 blocked horizontal pair, 2 singleton colors, 2 colors occurring more than twice, and 1 unaligned two-cell color, in addition to 11 clear horizontal pairs. A model trained only on the sampler can learn “connect every same-row duplicate on a clean sparse grid” and never learn the vertical branch or the authority's clear-path/frequency filters. Exact source-bound counts are in `checks/audit/audit_probe_report.json`; the reusable probe is `checks/audit/probe_generators.py`. The optional aggregate audit lint was interrupted at its time allowance and is retained as `checks/audit/80bd3177b03c-defect-lint.console.log`; it is not used as evidence for this finding. No repair was made.
